codemap.description: Project Territory Map and Architecture Map with execution flows, native VS Code LSP navigation, a built-in 4-mode AI assistant, and an MCP bridge for Cursor, Claude Code, and Codex.
codemap.map.expand: CodeMap: Open Full Map in Editor
codemap.agent.askSelection: CodeMap: Ask Architecture Map AI About Selection
codemap.mcp.setup: CodeMap: Connect External AI (Cursor / Claude Code / Codex MCP)
codemap.libraryPath.description: Relative or absolute path to the architecture map node library (for example, `codemap`). Share it through `.vscode/settings.json`.
codemap.defaultSurface.description: Default surface for newly opened maps: `panel` opens the editor area, `sidebar` opens the CodeMap side view.
codemap.followCursor.description: When enabled, the open map follows the active editor cursor and highlights the matching node or territory.
codemap.agent.maxParallel.description: Maximum number of architecture-map AI tasks that may run in parallel (1–8).
codemap.mcp.enabled.description: Enable the `127.0.0.1` loopback MCP bridge so Cursor, Claude Code, and Codex can read the current CodeMap.
codemap.welcome.title: Get started with CodeMap
codemap.welcome.description: Open a project territory, build an architecture map with AI, and connect Cursor, Claude Code, or Codex.
codemap.welcome.projectMap.title: See the project territory
codemap.welcome.projectMap.description: Open any folder and jump to the zero-config Project Map. [Open Project Map](command:codemap.projectMap.open)
codemap.welcome.aiBuild.title: Build the architecture map
codemap.welcome.aiBuild.description: Create the `codemap/` library, then let the built-in AI align the business model and draw execution flows. [Initialize Library](command:codemap.codemap.initLibrary) [AI & Model Settings](command:codemap.agent.openSettings)
codemap.welcome.externalMcp.title: Connect an external AI
codemap.welcome.externalMcp.description: Share the map with Cursor, Claude Code, or Codex over a local MCP bridge. [Connect External AI](command:codemap.mcp.setup)
